sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Divya Vats writes poetry alongside her work in parenting and personal development. In her public professional profile, she describes her association with Adith Aadvan Consultancy and her work as a parenting coach, counsellor and writer.

Her Hindi poem ‘हर एक सूर्यास्त की सुबह होगी’ approaches disappointment through images of renewal. A broken dream gives way to another dream; a closed door is answered by a new opening. The recurring movement from endings to beginnings gives this brief poem its reassuring rhythm, ending with the thought that what seems lost may return in another form.
